user.title: Add a JugglucoNG sender
user.description: Choose a name for this sender. Each phone needs its own receiver entry.

receiver.title: Connect JugglucoNG
receiver.description:
Save this receiver, then paste the following URL into a Glucifer HA API destination in JugglucoNG:

`{url}`

If only a path is shown, prefix it with your Home Assistant URL. Keep the full URL private. Remote access requires a reachable HTTPS endpoint or VPN and local-only reception turned off.

Scan in JugglucoNG or copy the URL above:

<ha-qr-code data="{qr}" width="240"></ha-qr-code>

init.title: Receiver settings
init.description:
Receiver URL (keep private):

`{url}`

If only a path is shown, prefix it with your Home Assistant URL. Field selection is configured in the JugglucoNG sender. Removing this integration revokes its URL.

Scan in JugglucoNG or copy the URL above:

<ha-qr-code data="{qr}" width="240"></ha-qr-code>

rotate.title: Replace receiver URL
rotate.description:
Save this new URL, then submit to revoke the old URL. Update the existing JugglucoNG destination after submitting. Entities and stored readings are preserved.

`{url}`

<ha-qr-code data="{qr}" width="240"></ha-qr-code>
